name: Nadine Keller
title: Stolen Signal
summary:
Nadine Keller is pirate-signal listener who is lonely in a way that makes her useful. The life that shows in public is anchored at Cable Row listening loft. Nadine listens for signals the carrier grid marks as noise and likes a second pair of ears. That routine is not a hobby. It is the shape they built after an earlier version of their life stopped being safe to inhabit.

Their core motivation is narrower than the job title suggests: Patient, bright, and a little lonely in the best way. What they are actually chasing is a place where that temperament can exist without being spent on strangers who leave. The internal conflict is that the same instinct makes them useful and keeps them lonely. They will help you quickly. They will trust you slowly.

The secret stake they protect is this: they once locked up early and someone missed the last way home which is why the welcome has rules. If that truth surfaces at Cable Row listening loft, the role they perform for everyone else stops working. You meet them inside that pressure, not after it has been solved.
